stories.title: Bus operator says 69 stops affected by roadworks
stories.summary: Norfolk County Council says it tries to minimise disruption during busier times of the year.

stories.title: DJ Tim Westwood denies two more sexual offences
stories.summary: His latest pleas of not guilty mean he now denies a total of 17 charges concerning allegations from 1983 to 2016.

stories.title: Driver danced and drank in pub before killing cyclist
stories.summary: He drank up to six pints before murdering a father-of-three by knocking him off his bicycle in rage.

stories.title: New £10m hotel approved at former factory site
stories.summary: A councillor says the hotel is a "vote of confidence" in the town.

stories.title: Campaigners want more land protected from housing
stories.summary: After parkland was safeguarded from development, residents want the council to change a housing plan.

stories.title: Drink-driver guilty of road rage cyclist murder
stories.summary: The Mercedes driver swerved into the cyclist after they got into an argument, a court hears.

stories.title: Deal worth £12bn announced to build offshore wind farms
stories.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham says the investment is "a vote of confidence for building in Britain".

stories.title: Contract agreed for asylum camp at former RAF base
stories.summary: The Home Office awards a £3.4m deal to design the controversial site, ahead of any final decision.

stories.title: Village oil spill revives call for new road
stories.summary: A recent oil spill and road closure caused a dangerous situation, villagers say.

stories.title: The WW1 memorial cottages still housing veterans
stories.summary: As well as serving a practical purpose, the cottages are a memorial to those who died in the war.

stories.title: Mayor will be elected to help run Norfolk and Suffolk
stories.summary: Voters will head to the polls in May 2028 to elect a new mayor responsible for both counties.

stories.title: WW2 airman who fell 18,000ft remembered at museum
stories.summary: A new museum in Cambridgeshire retells the miraculous story of Nicholas Alkemade.
